SELECT COUNT(*) FROM (
    SELECT DISTINCT c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    FROM (
        SELECT dd.d_date, c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name
        FROM date_dim dd
        JOIN store_sales ss ON dd.d_date_sk = ss.ss_sold_date_sk
        JOIN customer c ON ss.ss_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        WHERE dd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1200
        UNION ALL
        SELECT dd.d_date, c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name
        FROM date_dim dd
        JOIN catalog_sales cs ON dd.d_date_sk = cs.cs_sold_date_sk
        JOIN customer c ON cs.cs_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        WHERE dd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1200
        UNION ALL
        SELECT dd.d_date, c.c_last_name, c.c_first_name
        FROM date_dim dd
        JOIN web_sales ws ON dd.d_date_sk = ws.ws_sold_date_sk
        JOIN customer c ON ws.ws_bill_customer_sk = c.c_customer_sk
        WHERE dd.d_month_seq BETWEEN 1189 AND 1200
    ) AS combined
    GROUP BY c_last_name, c_first_name, d_date
    HAVING COUNT(*) = 3
) AS hot_cust
LIMIT 100
